verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A pair of clauses in a CNF formula constitutes a conflict if there is a variable that occurs positively in one clause and negatively in the other. verdicts.title: Feature Unification in TAG Derivation Trees
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The derivation trees of a tree adjoining grammar provide a first insight into the sentence semantics, and are thus prime targets for generation systems. We define a formalism, feature-based regular tree grammars, and a translation from feature based tree adjoining grammars into this new formalism. The translation preserves the derivation structures of the original grammar, and accounts for feature unification.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns tree adjoining grammars and feature unification in computational linguistics ('derivation trees of a tree adjoining grammar'), which has no interaction with Fourier analysis of clause counters or resolution refutation depth.
